entry.name: ServiceNow
entry.why: Long-running enterprise agent with memory/skills and policy enforcement at runtime; a direct benchmark for native agent authority and containment.
unverified: underlying Foundation, Advanced and Prime SKU prices
AI Passport GA and BlueField enforcement availability

snapshot.availability: Generally available as part of ServiceNow EmployeeWorks. The announcement says it is included at no additional cost with Foundation, Advanced and Prime SKUs; Mac support is live and Windows support is expected within weeks. AI Passport enforcement with NVIDIA OpenShell and BlueField is described as a future release.
features: long-running autonomous task ownership across workflows, email, Teams and other productivity tools
memory and skills that develop over time
runtime policy enforcement through Super Intelligence Control Tower and NVIDIA OpenShell
local inference option on NVIDIA RTX Spark for everyday tasks
action-level restrictions and revocation; vendor states propagation can be approximately one second

limitations: The GA announcement is official, but the dedicated product page, standalone tariff, Windows availability date and future AI Passport release are not independently confirmed.
entry.ARCHITECTURE_GAP: Candidate comparison: long-running task lifecycle, memory/skills, and action-level runtime policy enforcement. The current native implementation gap has not been audited in this monitoring run.

Tool/API/data access is denied by default and enforced at runtime.
Long-running tasks persist checkpoints without memory granting permissions.
Revocation and denial events are auditable and tied to an exact policy version.
